html:
News Digest:

Bain Capital has successfully completed fundraising for its latest Global Special Situations Fund, raising a total of $9 billion across its second vintage of funds. This includes $5.7 billion in commitments for Global Special Situations Fund II, which encompasses co-investments and separately managed accounts, alongside $3.3 billion secured through Bain Capital’s previously closed Special Situations Asia and Europe regional funds. This achievement cements Bain Capital’s position as one of the world’s largest special situations investors.
With more than $20 billion in assets under management, Bain Capital’s Special Situations strategy address the diverse needs of companies, entrepreneurs, and asset owners across varying market cycles. Leveraging expertise in credit, equity, and real assets, the team provides solutions beyond the scope of traditional providers.
Globally, Bain Capital focuses on three core investment strategies:
Capital Solutions: Partnering with companies to fund growth, mergers and acquisitions, liquidity needs, or capital structure optimization.
Hard Assets: Structuring tailored investments for asset owners and operators, building platforms to address market inefficiencies.
Opportunistic Distressed: Targeting complex, undervalued assets in disrupted markets.

End Notes
